about: RigTune's own footprint budgets (docs/v0.4/SPEC.md 10 and its WS-F amendment), read by FrameHookBudgetTest and FootprintGameTest. ceiling = the SPEC's ceiling (null where the SPEC sets none); limit = min(ceiling, 2 x the largest value observed in the calibration: 1 local run + 3 CI runs per leg, docs/v0.4/verification/footprint/README.md); heapGrowthAfterCyclesBytes uses 2 x the largest |delta| (it swings both ways). The monitor-on and sampler budgets stay at their ceilings until item 5 lands (F-L1). mode warn logs a value past its limit, fail fails the test.

renderThreadInitWallMs.what: wall time of RigTunePreLaunch + onInitializeClient on the render thread

renderThreadInitCpuMs.what: render-thread CPU time of RigTunePreLaunch + onInitializeClient

clientStartedWallMs.what: wall time of RigTune's CLIENT_STARTED handler (RealController.start) on the render thread

workerCpuMs5s.what: CPU of every RigTune thread in the 5 s after CLIENT_STARTED

frameHookNsPerCallOff.what: per-frame hook, ns per call, session monitor off (10 M calls)

frameHookAllocBytesOff.what: per-frame hook, bytes allocated, monitor off: the hot calls, or the first 10 M calls from cold beyond 4 KiB of JIT noise

frameHookNsPerCallOn.what: per-frame hook, ns per call, session monitor on (after WS-S)

frameHookAllocBytesOn.what: per-frame hook, bytes allocated as above, monitor on (after WS-S)

tickHookNsPerCall.what: RigTune's END_CLIENT_TICK hook, ns per call on the render thread

tickHookAllocBytes.what: RigTune's END_CLIENT_TICK hook, bytes allocated per 100,000 calls after warm-up

rigtuneClassBytesIdle.what: bytes of RigTune-class instances after a full GC at idle (class histogram, shallow)

heapGrowthAfterCyclesBytes.what: heap used after a full GC: after 20 RigTune screen + Tools open/close cycles minus before them

leakSuspects.what: RigTune classes with at least one more live instance per open/close cycle

monitorOffRetainedBytes.what: session monitor off again: StutterMonitor.retainedBytes() (after WS-S)

samplerCpuMsPer60s.what: "RigTune stutter sampler" CPU per 60 s with the monitor on (after WS-S)
